fields.description: Binghatti Cullinan is a curved residential and retail building in Al Jaddaf. Its apartments range from studios to three bedrooms, with a sheltered central leisure setting and varied balcony layouts. Selected larger drawings include extensive terraces; their outdoor area should be considered separately from interior living space.

overview: The brochure lists 624 homes across studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom categories. Its residential floors sit above a ground-floor and four-podium base; the scheme also contains retail.
The three-bedroom Type 2 drawing includes a pool terrace and labels some balcony portions non-accessible. Check usable outdoor space on the actual contract plan.
research.locationNote: Al Jaddaf, Dubai. The developer identifies connections towards Al Khail Road and Sheikh Zayed Road. Actual access,noise and views depend on the selected home.
research.priceNote: Binghatti’s own page displays AED 819999. Property Finder currently highlights AED 1399999 from its one-bedroom selection and marks developer stock sold out. Different unit categories and offer terms must not be compared as one current quotation.
research.paymentNote: The broker-hosted Binghatti-branded 2025 investor document visually states 20%down payment,50%during construction and 30%on completion, with monthly, bi-monthly or quarterly variants. Property Finder corroborates the aggregate split. No unit-specific calendar or present discount eligibility was established.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder gives June 2027. The retrieved primary project page, brochure and facts pack do not provide a dated completion commitment to independently confirm that forecast. Obtain a current developer update and signed-unit date.
